summary: Successfully completed comprehensive frontend testing of mobile navigation refactor and footer updates. All features working correctly - mobile multi-level navigation, desktop mega menu, and 6-column footer layout.
passed_tests: Mobile Navigation Tests:
- Hamburger menu button (data-testid='mobile-menu-btn') opens/closes correctly
- 'What We Do' button (data-testid='mobile-what-we-do-btn') present in mobile menu
- What We Do panel shows 4 categories: Services, Solutions, Industries, Practice Areas
- Services sub-panel shows 15+ service links with correct navigation
- Solutions sub-panel shows 9 solutions (All Solutions + 8 individual products)
- Industries sub-panel shows 16+ industry links with correct navigation
- Practice Areas sub-panel shows 16+ practice area links with correct navigation
- Back navigation buttons work correctly in all sub-panels
- Mobile menu closes after selecting a link
- Multi-level slide-out panel animations work smoothly
Desktop Mega Menu Tests:
- 'What We Do' mega menu button (data-testid='mega-menu-btn') triggers hover panel
- Mega menu has 4 tabs: Services, Solutions, Industries, Practice Areas
- Solutions tab displays all 9 solutions correctly
- Services tab displays services with icons and descriptions
- Navigation links from mega menu redirect correctly
Footer Tests:
- Footer element (data-testid='footer') present
- 6-column grid layout (lg:grid-cols-6) on large screens
- Brand column (spans 2 cols) with logo, description, social links, contact info
- Services column with 5 links (4 services + View All Services)
- Solutions column with 5 links (4 solutions + View All Solutions)
- Industries column with 5 links (4 industries + View All Industries)
- Company column with 4 links (About Us, Practice Areas, Insights, Contact)
- All footer links navigate to correct pages
Navigation Link Tests:
- Footer Services links (/services/*) redirect correctly
- Footer Solutions links (/solutions/*) redirect correctly
- Footer Industries links (/industries/*) redirect correctly
- Footer Company links (/about, /practice-areas, /insights, /contact) redirect correctly
- Mega menu links navigate to correct pages
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile navigation has been refactored from flat menu to multi-level slide-out panels matching desktop mega menu structure. Footer now has 6 columns: Brand (2 cols), Services, Solutions, Industries, Company. All data-testid attributes are in place for testing: mobile-menu-btn, mega-menu-btn, mobile-what-we-do-btn, mobile-services-btn, mobile-solutions-btn, mobile-industries-btn, mobile-practice-areas-btn, footer, footer-services-title, footer-solutions-title, footer-industries-title, footer-company-title.
